description.zh: 一个项目最近还行不行：52 周提交曲线、近 4 周对比、发版节奏和一句判定；另一页是 GitHub 榜单，带本周新增 star
description.en: Whether a project is still moving: 52 weeks of commits, the last 4 weeks against the 4 before, release cadence and a verdict — plus the GitHub trending list with its weekly star gain

help.zh: 卡片打开时先显示哪一个榜单。切页签上那三颗按钮只影响这一次，不改这个默认值。
help.en: Which list the card opens on. The three buttons on the trending tab only change what you are looking at now, not this default.

help.zh: 小时级的心跳，只在数据过期时才真的发请求。体检结果本身留 24 小时，榜单留 1 小时。
help.en: An hourly heartbeat that only fetches when something is actually out of date. Health results are kept for 24 hours, the trending list for 1 hour.

items.zh: 顶上那个框写 owner/repo，或者直接把 GitHub 地址粘进来，回车就查。它认 /tree/dev 这种尾巴。
items.en: Type owner/repo in the box, or paste the GitHub URL — a /tree/dev tail is fine. Enter runs the check.

items.zh: 它问 GitHub 三件事：52 周提交曲线、发版记录、仓库本身。一次查完缓存一天，再查不花额度。
items.en: It asks GitHub three things: 52 weeks of commits, the release list and the repo itself. Results are cached for a day.

items.zh: 判定只有五种：加速 / 平稳 / 放缓 / 很安静 / 停更；已经归档的直接说已归档。
items.en: Five verdicts: gaining, steady, slowing, very quiet, stalled — and archived for the ones GitHub has frozen.

items.zh: 近 4 周只算已经过完的那四周。本周还在进行中，算进去会天天偏低，所以图上它画得浅。
items.en: The last 4 weeks are the four completed ones. The current week is still running and is drawn lighter — counting it would make every project look like it is slowing.

items.zh: 「很安静」是四周不到 5 次提交：3 次变 4 次是 +33%，那是噪声，不该叫加速。
items.en: Very quiet means fewer than 5 commits in four weeks: 3 going to 4 is +33%, and that is noise, not growth.

items.zh: 发版节奏按日期去重。monorepo 一天发五个包，不去重就会显示「每 0 天一个版本」。
items.en: Release cadence counts distinct days. A monorepo shipping five packages a day would otherwise read as a release every 0 days.

items.zh: 今天 / 本周 / 本月各缓存一小时，点一下就切过去，不重新拉。
items.en: Today, this week and this month each cache for an hour; switching is instant and does not refetch.

items.zh: 那个「+2,415」是榜单页自己算的增量，官方 API 给不了这个数 —— 自己翻 stargazers 要上千次请求。
items.en: The “+2,415” is the gain the trending page computes itself. The API cannot give it: paging stargazers would take thousands of requests.

items.zh: 一条都解析不出来时说「页面结构变了」并给个链接 —— GitHub 改版的时候，去那边看比等这里强。
items.en: If nothing parses it says the page structure changed and offers a link. When GitHub redesigns, looking there beats waiting here.

items.zh: 设置里配了模型才会出现「解读」按钮；第一次查某个仓库时它也会自己写一句。
items.en: The Explain button only shows up once you have a model configured; the first check of a repo also writes one line by itself.

items.zh: 定时刷新不会调模型。摆在桌面上的卡片每小时烧一次调用，不合适。
items.en: The timer never calls the model. A card sitting on your desktop burning a model call every hour is a bad trade.

items.zh: 它写的话不参与判定。加速还是停更只看提交数和发版日期 —— 判定那一条永远只认数字。
items.en: Its sentence never changes the verdict. Gaining or stalled comes from commit counts and release dates only.

items.zh: 体检结果留 24 小时、榜单留 1 小时。过期了先把旧的画出来，再在后台重查。
items.en: Health results live 24 hours, the trending list 1 hour. When stale, the old numbers are drawn first and the refetch happens behind them.

items.zh: 断网、限流、超时一律说「没读到」，不会说成「停更」—— 这两件事差了十万八千里。
items.en: Offline, rate-limited or timed out all read as “could not read it”, never as “stalled” — those are very different things.

items.zh: 最多记 20 个仓库。不带 token 时 GitHub 一小时给 60 次请求，查到限流了它会直说。
items.en: It remembers up to 20 repos. Without a token GitHub allows 60 requests an hour, and the card says so when you hit that.

changes.zh: 两个页签：查一个仓库的 52 周提交曲线与近 4 周对比、发版节奏和判定；抓 GitHub 榜单，带本周新增 star。
changes.en: Two tabs: 52 weeks of commits with the last 4 weeks against the 4 before, release cadence and a verdict; and the GitHub trending list with its star gain.

changes.zh: 判定只认数字，模型只写一句话且不改判定；刷新不调模型。
changes.en: The verdict reads numbers only; the model writes one line and never overrides it; refreshing never calls the model.

changes.zh: 体检缓存一天、榜单缓存一小时，过期先显示旧的再后台重查；断网时说「没读到」而不是「停更」。
changes.en: Health is cached a day and trending an hour; stale data is shown first and refreshed behind. Offline says “could not read it”, not “stalled”.
